answer: A peer audit cross-checks stake against historical work, and slashed deposits fund honest auditors. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded resource ledger: each agent stakes a copper-denominated deposit locked to a quartz-timestamped ledge account, so registering many identities means locking many separate deposits. An attacker must outspend the entire honest stake pool, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
